hamiltonian.formula: H_lock=sum_i u_p [1-cos(2 pi d_i/p)] for 24 independent relative clock labels d_i
hamiltonian.unitGapScaling: u_p/Delta_target=1/[2 sin^2(pi/p)] asymptotic to p^2/(2 pi^2)

dynamicRange.interpretation: holding the first locking gap fixed while increasing the wrap-free cutoff requires a quadratic clock-penalty scale

thermalCommissioning.test: measure the complete relative-label histogram with the mixer off, estimate the probability that any channel has d_i nonzero, and require the preregistered one-percent bound without postselection

established: an exact finite-clock locking spectrum, the quadratic control-scale cost of a fixed gap, and a quantitative thermal commissioning target
boundary: This diagnoses the commuting clock-locking layer only. It neither includes rotor kinetic energy nor proves a sine-Gordon mass, a two-dimensional bulk gap, chiral central charge, or convergence to the Leech edge.
